packageRules.description: Merge non-major updates once every check passes. platformAutomerge is off because main has no required status checks, so GitHub auto-merge would merge before CI finishes; Renovate merges on a later run instead.
TypeScript updates change indexing output, and its minor releases can break, so they get their own PR and need review.
These versions appear in the snapshot output, so updates need `yarn update-snapshots` and would fail CI for the whole non-major group.
pnpm is also pinned in snapshot inputs and the Dockerfile, which Renovate doesn't update, so updates need manual changes.
Raising engines.node drops support for older Node versions that CI doesn't test, so change it by hand.
Major updates need review, including those the shared preset auto-merges, such as @types and lint tools.
